pollIntervalMs.description:
How often every feed is fetched, in milliseconds. Default 900000 (15 min); at least 60000 (a shorter one is taken as a
minute; 0, a negative or a non-number keeps the default).

Takes a whole number, 60000 and up. Default: 900000.

weekStart.description:
The first day of the week in the month view: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday ... 6 = Saturday (another value keeps the default). Default 1.

Takes a whole number 0 .. 6. Default: 1.

remind.x-wants: true or false, or a number 1 .. 1440

calendars.description:
The feeds, each an .ics URL (a Proton Calendar share link, for one). Per entry:
  id              a stable key for the feed. Default "cal<index>".
  name            what the popup calls it. Default "Calendar <n>".
  color           its events' colour, "#RRGGBB". Default the theme's text colour.
  url             the feed; required (an entry without one is skipped).
  pollIntervalMs  this feed's own fetch interval, in milliseconds. Default the top-level "pollIntervalMs".
  remind          whether its appointments are announced: true (as notifications.jsonc sources.calendar "leadMin" says) | false | a
                  number of minutes before (1 .. 1440). Default true.
Default: no calendars (the two below are a sample).

Takes a list of objects.
